name: SurvivalTargetOverride - Default (seed v1)
description: The NPC targeting override of one objective or one gate of a survival scenario (DESIGN §4): follow standard rules, explicitly allow or explicitly deny.

steps.description: Pick exactly one objective or one gate of the scenario. A denied objective is never captured; a denied gate is never attacked, not even on the way to an allowed objective. Allow makes the target eligible without boosting it. Targets without an override follow the standard rules.

fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: The siege scenario this belongs to; filled in from the scenario you are editing.

fields.label: Objective
fields.description: An objective of this scenario (leave empty when the override is for a gate).

fields.label: Gate
fields.description: One of the scenario's selected gates (leave empty when the override is for an objective).

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Standard: follow the rules. Allow: explicitly eligible. Deny: never a target.
